I will read webhook.go to locate the delivery function and the protection mechanism.

I also need to examine PostAsync and where DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook invokes it.

PostAsync in memo_service_webhooks.go enqueues the request. Post in webhook.go executes it via safeClient.Do.

`safeDialContext` in internal/webhook/webhook.go blocks internal addresses at dial time. `ValidateURL` and `isReservedIP` in internal/validate.go reject reserved CIDRs during URL registration. Async workers invoke `Post` from `init()` goroutines.

Outbound delivery executes in the `Post` function, which calls `safeClient`.

The `safeDialContext` guard in `webhook.go` blocks internal addresses at dial time. `ValidateURL` in `validate.go` rejects reserved CIDRs during webhook registration. Both mechanisms together protect outbound delivery.

The reserved CIDR list and `isReservedIP` logic live in `internal/webhook/validate.go`. `safeDialContext` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go` enforces the guard at dial time.

The final answer cites `Post` at `internal/webhook/webhook.go` as the delivery function, and `isReservedIP` / `reservedCIDRs` at `internal/webhook/validate.go` as the protection mechanism.

h02.

**Post** — `internal/webhook/webhook.go`; **isReservedIP / reservedCIDRs SSRF checks** (also enforced at dial time by `safeDialContext`) — `internal/webhook/validate.go`

Outbound HTTP delivery runs in `webhook.Post`, which sends the request via `safeClient.Do(req)` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:152`). Callers such as `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` only enqueue work with `webhook.PostAsync`; background workers in `init()` dequeue those payloads and call `Post` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:42-54`).

Internal-address protection is implemented by resolving the target hostname and rejecting reserved/private IPs (`127.0.0.0/8`, RFC 1918 ranges, link-local/IMDS, and IPv6 equivalents) in `isReservedIP` using `reservedCIDRs` (`internal/webhook/validate.go:11-54`). That check runs when webhook URLs are validated at registration (`ValidateURL`, `internal/webhook/validate.go:56-83`) and again at delivery time in `safeDialContext` on the webhook HTTP transport (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:57-77`), which blocks DNS rebinding to internal addresses. It can be disabled with the `AllowPrivateIPs` flag (`internal/webhook/validate.go:38-41`, set from `--allow-private-webhooks` in `cmd/memos/main.go:49`).
